The new file is `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

Nothing else in the repo uses `emial`, so no application code needed changing. I haven't run the migration.

Editing in place until release, like at your last job, is how the notifier service works here (`services/notifier/migrations/`). It hasn't launched, so you can edit those files directly until the planned launch in November 2026.
